architecture: C-RADIOv4-SO400M (ViT-SO400M/16 multi-teacher distilled from SigLIP2-g, DINOv3-7B, SAM3)
feature: official C-RADIOv4 summary output (concatenated teacher summary CLS tokens, 2 x 1152 = 2304D)
preprocessing: official CLIPImageProcessor with explicit RGB conversion, bicubic resize to preferred_resolution (512, 512), do_center_crop=false, do_rescale=true ([0,1]), do_normalize=false (model internal input_conditioner)
selection_protocol: per-sample L2 normalization, train-only 5-fold C selection, LinearSVC refit on 434 train images, one validation evaluation
notes: 2026 multi-teacher distilled vision foundation model (arXiv:2601.17237, released 2026-01-27). Uses official preferred_resolution 512x512 bicubic resize without center cropping to avoid clipping narrow Bai border patterns and to stay within 8 GiB VRAM.
